001-muller-lyer.title: Which Line Is Longer? Your Brain Gets This Wrong #shorts

002-afterimage-flag.title: Stare at This Flag for 20 Seconds, Then Look at the White 👁️ #shorts
lines: Stare at the white dot. Don't blink.
Keep your eyes on the dot for twenty seconds. Don't look away.
These colours look wrong. Your eyes are getting tired of them.
Now look at the white. Red, white and blue! It's a negative afterimage: tired cells in your eyes show you the opposite colours. Now look again.

003-ebbinghaus.title: Which Orange Circle Is Bigger? Brain Test #1 🧠 #shorts
lines: Which orange circle is bigger? A or B?
Now let's take the other circles away.
It's called the Ebbinghaus illusion. Your brain judges size by what's around it. Now look again.

004-blind-spot.title: Close Your Left Eye. This Dot Will Disappear 👁️ #shorts
lines: Close your left eye. Stare at the cross.
Now bring your phone closer. Slowly.
Keep staring at the cross. Don't look at the dot.
At the right distance, the dot is gone.
It hit your blind spot, where the optic nerve leaves the eye. Your brain fills the hole.
A French scientist found it over three hundred years ago. Now look again.
